title: Data import
summary: Move customers, products, prices, opening stock and opening balances in from spreadsheets. Every row is checked first; nothing is posted until you commit, and a commit posts all rows or none.
errorTitle: This page could not be shown
errorBody: Something went wrong while loading the import. Nothing was changed.

synthetic.title: Synthetic data only
synthetic.body: Until the legal review of personal data (decision D-03) is complete, import only made-up test data. Do not upload real customer names, phone numbers, addresses or balances.

steps.one: Download the template for what you are importing and fill it in a spreadsheet.
steps.two: Save it as CSV (UTF-8). Excel files (.xlsx) are not accepted. At most {max} rows per file.
steps.three: Upload it, check the preview, then validate. Fix the rejected rows (download the errors file) and upload again.
steps.four: When every row is valid, commit. All rows are posted in one step, or none are.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.fileHint: Save as CSV (UTF-8). Excel (.xlsx) is not supported. Up to 900 KB and 5,000 rows.
upload.noKinds: You do not have the permissions any import needs.

problems.no_file: Choose a CSV file to upload.
problems.too_large: The file is larger than 900 KB. Split it into smaller files.
problems.not_text: This is not a UTF-8 CSV file. In your spreadsheet choose Save as → CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited). Excel files (.xlsx) are not accepted.
problems.unterminated_quote: A quoted value that starts on line {line} is never closed. Check the quotes in the file.
problems.unexpected_quote: Line {line} has a quote in the middle of a value. Save the file again as CSV from your spreadsheet.
problems.empty: The file has a header row but no data rows.
problems.too_many_rows: The file has {count} rows; the limit is 5,000. Split it into smaller files.
problems.duplicate_header: The column {column} appears twice in the header row.
problems.unknown_columns: These columns are not part of this template: {columns}. Use the template's header row.
problems.extra_cells: Line {line} has more values than the header has columns.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Headers stay in English exactly as in the template. The examples are made-up rows: replace them.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Clinics, doctors, hospitals and labs. Each becomes a lead with source “import”; a phone already registered is rejected.

products.title: Products and variants
products.description: One row per SKU. Rows with the same product code create one product; an existing product code adds variants to it.

customer_prices.title: Customer price lists
customer_prices.description: Customer-specific prices. A new list code creates a customer price list; each customer in the file is assigned to it.

opening_stock.title: Opening stock
opening_stock.description: Stock on hand by warehouse, lot and expiry. Posted as goods receipts, so every unit is a receipt movement in the inventory ledger.

opening_ar.title: Opening balances (AR)
opening_ar.description: What each customer owes on the start date: one opening balance entry in the customer ledger. Negative = credit in the customer's favour.

columns.doctor_name: Doctor's name. Doctor or clinic name is required.
columns.clinic_name: Clinic name. Doctor or clinic name is required.
columns.display_name: Name shown in lists (optional; built from clinic and doctor when empty).
columns.kind: clinic, doctor, hospital, university, lab or distributor (default clinic).
columns.specialty_code: Specialty code, e.g. IMPLANTOLOGY, ENDO, ORTHO, GP.
columns.phone_primary: Main phone, Egyptian format: 01xxxxxxxxx or +201xxxxxxxxx. Must be unique.
columns.governorate_code: Governorate code, e.g. EG-C (Cairo), EG-GZ (Giza), EG-ALX (Alexandria).
columns.territory_code: Territory code (optional; otherwise taken from the coverage map).
columns.rep_employee_no: Employee number of the primary sales rep (optional).
columns.product_code: Product code: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
columns.brand_code: Brand code: BIONER, DERBY or RDT (new products only).
columns.category_code: Category code, e.g. IMPLANT, BUR, INSTRUMENT (new products only).
columns.product_name_en: Product name in English (new products only).
columns.variant_name_en: Variant name in English, e.g. 4.1 x 10 mm.
columns.customer_no: Customer number (CUS-…). Customer number or phone is required.
columns.customer_phone: Customer's main phone. Customer number or phone is required.
columns.price_list_code: Price list code. A new code creates a customer price list.
columns.price_list_name: Price list name (needed once for a new list).
columns.unit_price: Price in EGP, at most 2 decimals, no thousands separators.
columns.lot_no: Lot number (NO-LOT for products without lots).
columns.expiry_date: Expiry date YYYY-MM-DD (required when the product tracks expiry).
columns.quantity: Quantity on hand, whole number above 0.
columns.unit_cost: Purchase cost per unit in EGP (optional when the catalogue has a cost).
columns.amount: Amount owed in EGP on the start date; negative for a credit.

batch.title: Import batch
batch.notValidatedYet: Check the preview below, then validate the file.
batch.discarded: This batch was discarded and its rows were deleted. Nothing was posted.
batch.failureTitle: The commit was refused. Nothing was posted.
batch.failureRow: It stopped at spreadsheet row {row}. Fix the data, validate again and commit.
batch.failureNoRow: Fix the data, validate again and commit.
batch.commitCheckbox: I checked the preview. Post all {count} rows now. This cannot be undone by deleting; corrections are made as new entries.
batch.discardConfirm: Discard this batch? Its rows will be deleted.

outcome.validated: Every row is valid. You can commit now.
outcome.rejected: Some rows were rejected. See the list below.
outcome.commitRefused: The commit was refused and nothing was posted. See the reason above.

rejects.title: Rejected rows ({count})
rejects.intro: Download the errors file, fix the rows in your spreadsheet, remove the sheet_row and errors columns and upload them as a new file.
rejects.more: Only the first {shown} are shown here; the errors file has them all.

preview.title: Preview
preview.intro: The first {shown} of {total} rows, as uploaded.

rowErrors.duplicate_in_file: appears more than once in the file
rowErrors.inconsistent: does not match other rows for the same item
rowErrors.expired: is in the past (only a quarantine warehouse may receive expired stock)
rowErrors.mismatch: does not match what is already recorded
rowErrors.overlap: overlaps an existing assignment of this list
rowErrors.wrong_kind: is the wrong kind for this import

errors.ALREADY_COMMITTED: This batch was already committed. It cannot be committed, validated or discarded again.
errors.CONFLICT: This upload was already used for a different file. Reload the page and upload again.
errors.INVALID_STATE: That step is not possible now. Validate the batch first; a discarded batch cannot be used.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission to run this import.
errors.CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Tick the confirmation box before committing.
errors.VALIDATION: The file could not be staged. Check the columns against the template.
